title: If you are visiting...
text:
If you are visiting Barcelona and desire to see life outside the city, a visit to Sitges is a must.

Rather than take a bus or train to Sitges, we scheduled a private tour to Sitges.  Sergey, our tour guide, picked us up and returned us near our hotel which made the trip effortless.  

Once we arrived, our guide walked us past the 17th Century church of St. Bartholomew and St. Techia while talking about the history of its construction on foundations of earlier Romanesque and medieval Gothic temples. title: A reunion
text:
A lovely city. It has grown so much since our last visit so many years ago. 
A private tour with a delightful young couple. We completely enjoyed the tour and the conversation.  We were driven back to our hotel which was not included. 
Completey recommend.
author: B_W

title: We had a wonderful trip...
text: We had a wonderful trip with Alexandra and Sergei! They were so informative about the town and took us wherever we asked. They were very accommodating and easy to talk to
author: Samantha_R

title: Well recommended!
text: We had a wonderful trip to Sitges with Sergei and Alexandra.  We were taken around the old town, museum and explored some of the beaches.  The pace of the trip was considerately paced to suit us two elderly travellers.
author: Dennis_E
